proof_scope: Secret redaction at the capturer: credential-shaped paused state (scenarios/secret_capture/leaky.py) must be redacted before it is written into a proof artifact -- caught by variable name and by value shape -- while non-secret locals pass through, so the proof still demonstrates the stop without leaking the credential.

claims.proves: capture_breakpoints.py redacts secret-like locals/watches (by name and by value) in the proof it writes, selectively, leaving non-secret state intact
claims.does_not_prove: redaction in the VS Code bridge artifacts or in human-facing status surfaces -- those paths are separate and remain open on #1440

cases.name: secrets-redacted-in-proof
cases.description: Break where user/password/api_token/canary/ok are all bound, capture them, and confirm no secret bytes reach the proof and each credential-shaped local is a redaction marker.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; D="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/secret_capture/*.py "$D/"; export PYTHONPATH="$D"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/capture_breakpoints.py --break "$D/leaky.py:14" --local password --local api_token --local canary --local ok --out "$D/proof.json" -- "$D/leaky.py"; python3 ../scenarios/secret_capture/check_redaction.py "$D/proof.json" noleak

cases.name: innocuous-name-secret-caught-by-value
cases.description: The canary local has an innocuous name but a JWT-shaped value; name-only redaction would leak it. Prove value-shape redaction catches it.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; D="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/secret_capture/*.py "$D/"; export PYTHONPATH="$D"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/capture_breakpoints.py --break "$D/leaky.py:14" --local canary --local ok --out "$D/proof.json" -- "$D/leaky.py"; python3 ../scenarios/secret_capture/check_redaction.py "$D/proof.json" value

cases.name: non-secret-local-not-over-redacted
cases.description: Redaction must be selective: a non-secret local must survive verbatim, or a blanket redactor would make the proof useless. This asserts ok==True is not redacted.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; D="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/secret_capture/*.py "$D/"; export PYTHONPATH="$D"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/capture_breakpoints.py --break "$D/leaky.py:14" --local password --local ok --out "$D/proof.json" -- "$D/leaky.py"; python3 ../scenarios/secret_capture/check_redaction.py "$D/proof.json" selective
